title: Aethelgard Factions
purpose: Reference for powers, organizations, houses, military groups, and political forces appearing or planned for the novel.

entries.name: House Valerius
entries.reputation: A dominant High-Reach bloodline associated with extraction, centralized rule, propaganda, and control of magical infrastructure.
entries.story_use: The source of Abel's inherited guilt and the political history driving hostility toward him.
entries.notes: Abel rejects the family's authority and has been permanently banished by King Cassian. Lady Vivienne is Abel's mother.

entries.name: Skull-Veil Inquisitors
entries.reputation: A feared elven force associated with bone-alchemy, pursuit, imprisonment, and brutal frontier enforcement.
entries.story_use: Their reputation should remain frightening. The outcasts should not become comfortable around them merely because individual encounters can vary.
entries.notes: Skull-Veil is a nickname for the elves/order, not the name of the fissure creatures.

entries.name: Kael-Vossen Assembly
entries.reputation: Protective, suspicious, politically sophisticated, and deeply hostile toward House Valerius.
entries.story_use: The political authority Abel must face after entering Kael-Vossen.

entries.name: Silt-Sinks High-Reach Authority
entries.reputation: A coercive hierarchy built around the Spire, royal authority, extraction, and control of marginalized populations.
entries.story_use: Primary political antagonist structure behind the group's flight.

entries.name: Silt Guard
entries.reputation: A regional force connected to the Zul-Thar marshlands and Kaelen's family history.
entries.story_use: Background for Kaelen Vane-Skar and his inherited loyalties.
